usage: 排骨湯 is used as a noun to refer to a soup dish made with pork ribs.
You can use 排骨湯 to order this dish in a restaurant setting.
It is usually used in a sentence to describe what you want to eat or drink, e.g., '我要一碗排骨湯' (I want a bowl of pork rib soup).
排骨湯 can appear as the subject or object in a sentence.
It often comes with measure words like '碗' (bowl) or '杯' (cup) when you talk about portions.
